**Oxevy 7.3.4 — web UI overhaul + config share codes.**

### ⚠️ MCEF is required (Minecraft 1.21.11)

All menus (main menu, ClickGUI, pause screen, accounts, cosmetics, config
manager) render through **MCEF**. For Minecraft **1.21.11** you must install
**[`mcef-modern` `0.3.3+mc1.21.11.jcef146.0.10`](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcef-modern)**
next to Oxevy — without it Fabric Loader rejects the mod.

### Downloads

| Jar | Minecraft | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `oxevy-7.3.4-mc1.21.11.jar` | 1.21.11 | ✅ **mainline** — MCEF required |
| `oxevy-2.5.8-mc1.21.8.jar` | 1.21.8 | ⚠️ **outdated, not mainline** — frozen snapshot, no MCEF/web UIs |
| `oxevy-2.5.8-mc1.21.4.jar` | 1.21.4 | ⚠️ **outdated, not mainline** — frozen snapshot, no MCEF/web UIs |

Version branches: [`main`](https://github.com/danek2137/oxevy-2.0) /
[`1.21.11`](https://github.com/danek2137/oxevy-2.0/tree/1.21.11) = current

[`1.21.4`](https://github.com/danek2137/oxevy-2.0/tree/1.21.4) = outdated
snapshots kept only for players on older versions.

### What's new

- **Transparent liquid-glass UIs** — main menu and overlays are blurred glass;
  the game is no longer darkened behind them
- **Config manager everywhere** — the same panel opens from the main menu and
  from the ClickGUI's *Configs* tab, with a **+** tile in the Load grid to
  create configs inline (import `.json` / redeem a friend's config)
- **Config share codes** — export any config as a single `OXEVY1D:…` string
  and redeem it on another player's client
- **Cosmetics fix** — the headband now renders on the head (3 px band geometry)
- MCEF (`mcef-modern`) is now a declared **hard dependency**

### Install

1. Java 21
2. [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.19.x + Fabric API for your version
3. **[MCEF `mcef-modern`](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcef-modern)** *(1.21.11 only)*
4. Drop the jar into `mods/`

Full instructions: [README](https://github.com/danek2137/oxevy-2.0#installation-players)
